rules.commercial_training: Only sources marked commercial_ok may enter production training automatically.
rules.plate_privacy: Government traffic-camera imagery is vehicle-domain data only; mask/blur plate regions before retention.
rules.syntax_control: Foreign plate text must never define Australian OCR grammar.
rules.final_domain: Corrected gate data has the highest curriculum weight.

sources.name: CCPD License Plate Localization Backbone Pretraining Corpus
sources.notes: Backbone/localisation warm-up only. Maintainer explicitly warns against final geographic fine-tuning; currently not required for Phase 2 promotion because justjuu + TLPD provide the generic stage.

sources.name: justjuu/license-plate-detection
sources.notes: Single-class plate boxes. Production-compatible generic localisation warm-up; never defines Australian OCR grammar.

sources.name: TLPD: Taiwan License Plate Dataset
sources.notes: Expert polygon plate labels. Used for generic localisation warm-up only; Australian adaptation follows so foreign plate shape is not the final domain.

sources.name: AU-NSW-WHITE
sources.notes: NSW white plates; object-detection boxes only.

sources.name: australian-license-plates
sources.notes: ACT, NSW white, NT, SA plate classes; detection labels, not verified OCR transcriptions.

sources.name: Licence Plates Australia
sources.notes: Additional Australian plate detection source; audit class semantics before mixing.

sources.name: Live Traffic NSW camera GeoJSON + JPEG frames
sources.notes: Public GeoJSON advertises current NSW camera metadata and JPEG hrefs. Use original frames only as road/vehicle domain data; generated plate overlays carry their own synthetic labels. Do not treat visible real registration text as OCR ground truth.

sources.name: TfNSW Registered Heavy Vehicles by Configuration Snapshot 2026
sources.notes: Current NSW heavy-vehicle configuration counts; use to weight sampling/prior probabilities.

sources.name: Telemetry Traffic Counts and Classification 2026
sources.notes: Austroads 4-bin and 12-bin vehicle classes; updated July 2026.

sources.name: Road vehicles Australia, January 2025
sources.notes: Use as fleet-distribution prior, not image training data.

sources.name: Mixed Signals V2X
sources.notes: Sydney real-world V2X; 8,394 train frames and 124,668 public 3D boxes. Do not use in commercial production weights.

sources.name: LRLPR-26
sources.notes: 20k training tracks with 5 LR + 5 HR images and text labels; benchmark/architecture research only.

sources.name: NARRATE
sources.notes: 2,050 Australian driving events from 35 drivers; multimodal context.

sources.name: ANPR-Australia / Revenue NSW
sources.notes: Useful historical NSW/QLD/TAS pattern and plate-dimension references; not a modern dataset.

sources.name: Austroads-26 concept architecture
sources.notes: CORE/LENGTH/PLUS Visual architecture; phased release late 2026/early 2027.

sources.name: NHVR 3-axle truck + 4-axle dog Notice 2026
sources.notes: Defines the current 7-axle 3-axle rigid + 4-axle dog configuration and related visual/geometry cues.

sources.name: MRTMD
sources.notes: Not Australian. Useful as multi-resolution OCR/vehicle robustness benchmark; includes ground-truth plate text.

sources.name: UniDataPro global license plate OCR
sources.notes: Australia included, but public preview is not enough for production training; license the Australian subset explicitly before use.
